text:
jordan-support: Hi team, customer ACME reporting multiple dashboard graphs not loading. They see blank tiles and error: 'connection reset by peer' from analytics API. Root request id: req-0a1b2c. Can we triage?
ingrid-eng: thanks Jordan. Which route/model are they hitting? any quick repro steps?
acme-sre: Happens on our account when we open the "usage_over_time" dashboard. Steps: 1) login -> 2) open /dash/usage -> 3) click last 7d. Happens ~30% of loads. We see 502/ECONNRESET in browser console.
sam-frontend: noted. Can you paste the full network error and response headers if available? Header from fetch: `x-request-id: req-0a1b2c`, `via: analytics-proxy/1.9`, status: 502.
lucas-sre: I pulled logs for req-0a1b2c from analytics-proxy around 2026-05-03T14:12:34Z. Proxy upstream returned RST; backend connection died mid-stream. Suspect short-lived KV cache mismatch causing pipeline to abort.
jordan-support: attaching the stack trace the customer pasted: ```Error: read ECONNRESET\n    at TLSWrap.onread (node:net:...)\nRequest-ID: req-0a1b2c\nRoute: /api/analytics/v1/query```
ingrid-eng: lucas, are there any recent proxy or kernel rollouts? deploy-bot: deploy completed: analytics-proxy v1.9.2 -> v1.10.0 at 2026-05-03T13:57:00Z by ci-pipeline.
lucas-sre: there was a sticky change to keepalive settings in v1.10.0, might impact connection reuse. I'll grep for error spikes.
maria-product: ACME is paying Dedicated plan; high priority. Are we auto-failing over to cold nodes?
lucas-sre: early numbers: between 13:55-14:30 we saw 0.6% connection resets vs baseline 0.02%. Also a small burst of kv-cache-miss errors correlated with the same timeframe.
sam-frontend: could be frontend's continuous batching + connection reuse interaction. If prefix cache responses are being evicted while the proxy reuses backend sockets, that could yield truncated reads.
acme-sre: workaround for us is to refresh the page and graphs load on retry. But it's noisy for users.
jordan-support: repro steps from our side: curl to proxy: ```curl -v -H "x-request-id: req-0a1b2c-test" "https://analytics.redwood.example/api/analytics/v1/query" --data-binary @payload.json``` repeated 10x, ~1 in 20 attempts returned connection reset.
ingrid-eng: I pushed a canary rollback option to hold at v1.9.2 for a subset of proxy nodes. lucas, can you route the ACME traffic to the stable pool?
lucas-sre: done. Re-routed ACME to stable pool at 2026-05-03T15:02:10Z. Monitoring now.
maria-product: letting customer know we routed them off the canary and investigating root cause.
analytics-proxy-bot: Alert resolved for ACME, error rate down to baseline after re-route.
acme-sre: Confirmed from our side — graphs load consistently now. Thanks.
jordan-support: Next actions: 1) roll back keepalive change or tune timeouts; 2) add additional metrics to monitor kv-cache eviction + socket resets; 3) run replay load against canary to reproduce. Assigning to ingrid and lucas.
ingrid-eng: I'll prepare a repro harness and share results.
lucas-sre: I'll open a postmortem if rollback happens. For now marking as mitigated. :thumbsup:
